tool_args.rationale: The epidemic mobility bridge points to the inland-hub siphon, but the pilot has zero s_grad span. The open-branch probe directly resolves the missing gradient dependence and branch ambiguity before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon with a square-root branch immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so the sink inhibition parameter is not identifiable; the branch sign or linear-leak alternative also remains open.

considered_alternatives.option: Cooperative Hill or barrier-modulated siphon models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: They can produce competing saturation curves and likewise need varied sink gradients to distinguish them.
The bridge and flux-conservation signatures favor the static siphon family; a fine trajectory is less targeted and more expensive.
